name: Pushing Together [1-4 PLAYER]
desc:
💪Welcome to Pushing Together!💪

One goal: Push a giant boulder to the top of the mountain.

- 🎮 Play solo or with friends
- ⛰️ Push the boulder to the top
- ⚠️ Watch out for hazards along the way
- 🚩Reach checkpoints to help you recover
- 💰Collect coins to buy skins for your boulder

Push together. Rage together. Win together.
